article.title: Time to push back: On India and the continuing U.S. pressure
article.subtitle: The U.S. has been emboldened to make increasing demands and India needs to start pushing back

tone.summary: Argues that repeated trade concessions weaken domestic autonomy and urges firm resistance against external tariff pressure.

body_paragraphs: The latest accusation levelled by the United States against India has the potential to be the most harmful to the Indian economy. A recent White House report, naming around 40 countries in all, has said that India ranks among the top 'enablers' of China's evasion of U.S. tariffs...
The fact that Chinese imports form a significant pillar of Indian manufacturing is no secret. Yet, the nature of these imports is slowly changing...

vocabulary.definition: The act of avoiding or escaping a duty, tax, or legal obligation through indirect methods.
vocabulary.example: The industrialist faced severe penalties after auditors uncovered an elaborate scheme of tax evasion.

vocabulary.definition: Intended as a punishment or penalty to deter specific actions.
vocabulary.example: The trading bloc threatened punitive duties on steel imports to protect domestic factories.

vocabulary.definition: Expressing views or opinions in a forceful, loud, and uncompromising way.
vocabulary.example: The diplomat delivered a strident defence of national strategic autonomy during the bilateral summit.

fixed_prepositions.meaning: Officially directed or aimed (charges/allegations) by someone.
Submitting or yielding to external authority or demands.

phrasal_verbs.meaning: Complained angrily or fiercely against a policy.
Shifting investments or purchases away from a single source.

article.study_tip: Note the fixed collocation: 'Bowing to' requires the preposition 'to'—frequently tested in Sentence Fillers and Error Spotting.
